functions.name: HAL_CAN_Init

params.name: hcan
params.descEn: pointer to a CAN_HandleTypeDef structure that contains the configuration information for the specified CAN.

functions.briefEn: Initializes the CAN peripheral according to the specified parameters in the CAN_InitStruct.
functions.briefZh: 按 InitTypeDef 中的参数初始化 CAN，并完成状态机初始化。

functions.name: HAL_CAN_DeInit

params.name: hcan
params.descEn: pointer to a CAN_HandleTypeDef structure that contains the configuration information for the specified CAN.

functions.briefEn: Deinitializes the CAN peripheral registers to their default reset values.
functions.briefZh: 把 CAN 的寄存器恢复成复位默认值，并调用 MspDeInit 释放底层资源。

functions.name: HAL_CAN_MspInit

params.name: hcan
params.descEn: pointer to a CAN_HandleTypeDef structure that contains the configuration information for the specified CAN.

functions.briefZh: MSP 底层初始化回调（__weak 空实现）：时钟使能、GPIO 与 NVIC 配置应写在这里。

functions.name: HAL_CAN_MspDeInit

params.name: hcan
params.descEn: pointer to a CAN_HandleTypeDef structure that contains the configuration information for the specified CAN.

functions.briefZh: MSP 底层反初始化回调（__weak 空实现）：关闭时钟、释放引脚。

functions.name: HAL_CAN_RegisterCallback

params.name: hcan
params.descEn: pointer to a CAN_HandleTypeDef structure that contains the configuration information for CAN module

params.name: CallbackID
params.descEn: ID of the callback to be registered This parameter can be one of the following values:
params.descZh: 回调事件的编号，取 HAL_<外设>_CallbackIDTypeDef 里的枚举值（如 HAL_UART_TX_COMPLETE_CB_ID）。

params.name: pCallback
params.descEn: pointer to the Callback function
params.descZh: 回调函数指针。签名必须与 HAL 里定义的 typedef 完全一致，否则编译能过但调用时会崩溃。

functions.briefEn: Register a CAN CallBack. To be used instead of the weak predefined callback
functions.briefZh: 为 CAN 注册指定事件的回调，替代默认的 __weak 空实现。

functions.name: HAL_CAN_UnRegisterCallback

params.name: hcan
params.descEn: pointer to a CAN_HandleTypeDef structure that contains the configuration information for CAN module

params.name: CallbackID
params.descEn: ID of the callback to be unregistered This parameter can be one of the following values:
params.descZh: 回调事件的编号，取 HAL_<外设>_CallbackIDTypeDef 里的枚举值（如 HAL_UART_TX_COMPLETE_CB_ID）。

functions.briefEn: Unregister a CAN CallBack. CAN callback is redirected to the weak predefined callback
functions.briefZh: 注销 CAN 已注册的回调，恢复成默认的 __weak 空实现。

functions.name: HAL_CAN_ConfigFilter

params.name: hcan
params.descEn: pointer to a CAN_HandleTypeDef structure that contains the configuration information for the specified CAN.

params.name: sFilterConfig
params.descEn: pointer to a CAN_FilterTypeDef structure that contains the filter configuration information.
params.descZh: 过滤器配置结构体：FilterBank、FilterMode（掩码/列表）、FilterScale、FilterIdHigh/Low、FilterMaskIdHigh/Low、FilterFIFOAssignment、FilterActivation。

functions.briefEn: Configures the CAN reception filter according to the specified parameters in the CAN_FilterInitStruct.
functions.briefZh: 配置接收过滤器。不配置过滤器时所有报文都会被丢弃——这是 CAN 收不到数据的头号原因。

functions.name: HAL_CAN_Start

params.name: hcan
params.descEn: pointer to an CAN_HandleTypeDef structure that contains the configuration information for the specified CAN.

functions.briefZh: 启动 CAN。

functions.name: HAL_CAN_Stop

params.name: hcan
params.descEn: pointer to an CAN_HandleTypeDef structure that contains the configuration information for the specified CAN.

functions.briefEn: Stop the CAN module and enable access to configuration registers.
functions.briefZh: 停止 CAN。

functions.name: HAL_CAN_RequestSleep

params.name: hcan
params.descEn: pointer to a CAN_HandleTypeDef structure that contains the configuration information for the specified CAN.

functions.briefEn: Request the sleep mode (low power) entry. When returning from this function, Sleep mode will be entered as soon as the current CAN activity (transmission or reception of a CAN frame) has been completed.
functions.briefZh: 请求进入睡眠模式（总线空闲后生效）。

functions.name: HAL_CAN_WakeUp

params.name: hcan
params.descEn: pointer to a CAN_HandleTypeDef structure that contains the configuration information for the specified CAN.

functions.briefEn: Wake up from sleep mode. When returning with HAL_OK status from this function, Sleep mode is exited.
functions.briefZh: 请求从睡眠模式唤醒。

functions.name: HAL_CAN_IsSleepActive

params.name: hcan
params.descEn: pointer to a CAN_HandleTypeDef structure that contains the configuration information for the specified CAN.

functions.returnDescEn: Status - 0 : Sleep mode is not active. - 1 : Sleep mode is active.
functions.briefEn: Check is sleep mode is active.
functions.briefZh: 查询 CAN 是否已进入睡眠状态。

functions.name: HAL_CAN_AddTxMessage
functions.prototype: HAL_StatusTypeDef HAL_CAN_AddTxMessage(CAN_HandleTypeDef *hcan, const CAN_TxHeaderTypeDef *pHeader, const uint8_t aData[], uint32_t *pTxMailbox);

params.name: hcan
params.descEn: pointer to a CAN_HandleTypeDef structure that contains the configuration information for the specified CAN.

params.name: pHeader
params.descEn: pointer to a CAN_TxHeaderTypeDef structure.
params.descZh: 报文头结构体：StdId/ExtId（标识符）、IDE（标准帧/扩展帧）、RTR（数据帧/远程帧）、DLC（数据长度 0~8）。

params.name: aData
params.descEn: array containing the payload of the Tx frame.
params.descZh: 数据数组指针。CAN 每帧最多 8 字节（标准帧）。

params.name: pTxMailbox
params.descEn: pointer to a variable where the function will return the TxMailbox used to store the Tx message. This parameter can be a value of @arg CAN_Tx_Mailboxes.
params.descZh: 输出参数，返回本次使用的发送邮箱编号（0~2）。

functions.briefEn: Add a message to the first free Tx mailbox and activate the corresponding transmission request.
functions.briefZh: 把一个报文放进发送邮箱，由硬件自动仲裁发送。

functions.name: HAL_CAN_AbortTxRequest

params.name: hcan
params.descEn: pointer to an CAN_HandleTypeDef structure that contains the configuration information for the specified CAN.

params.name: TxMailboxes
params.descEn: List of the Tx Mailboxes to abort. This parameter can be any combination of @arg CAN_Tx_Mailboxes.
params.descZh: 发送邮箱位掩码：CAN_TX_MAILBOX0 | CAN_TX_MAILBOX1 | CAN_TX_MAILBOX2。

functions.briefZh: 请求中止某个发送邮箱里待发的报文。

functions.name: HAL_CAN_GetTxMailboxesFreeLevel

params.name: hcan
params.descEn: pointer to a CAN_HandleTypeDef structure that contains the configuration information for the specified CAN.

functions.briefEn: Return Tx Mailboxes free level: number of free Tx Mailboxes.
functions.briefZh: 读取还有几个发送邮箱空闲。

functions.name: HAL_CAN_IsTxMessagePending

params.name: hcan
params.descEn: pointer to an CAN_HandleTypeDef structure that contains the configuration information for the specified CAN.

params.name: TxMailboxes
params.descEn: List of Tx Mailboxes to check. This parameter can be any combination of @arg CAN_Tx_Mailboxes.
params.descZh: 发送邮箱位掩码：CAN_TX_MAILBOX0 | CAN_TX_MAILBOX1 | CAN_TX_MAILBOX2。

functions.returnDescEn: Status - 0 : No pending transmission request on any selected Tx Mailboxes. - 1 : Pending transmission request on at least one of the selected Tx Mailbox.
functions.briefEn: Check if a transmission request is pending on the selected Tx Mailboxes.
functions.briefZh: 查询指定发送邮箱里的报文是否还没发出去。

functions.name: HAL_CAN_GetTxTimestamp

params.name: hcan
params.descEn: pointer to a CAN_HandleTypeDef structure that contains the configuration information for the specified CAN.

params.name: TxMailbox
params.descEn: Tx Mailbox where the timestamp of message sent will be read. This parameter can be one value of @arg CAN_Tx_Mailboxes.

functions.returnDescEn: Timestamp of message sent from Tx Mailbox.
functions.briefEn: Return timestamp of Tx message sent, if time triggered communication mode is enabled.
functions.briefZh: 读取某个发送邮箱的发送时间戳。

functions.name: HAL_CAN_GetRxMessage
functions.prototype: HAL_StatusTypeDef HAL_CAN_GetRxMessage(CAN_HandleTypeDef *hcan, uint32_t RxFifo, CAN_RxHeaderTypeDef *pHeader, uint8_t aData[]);

params.name: hcan
params.descEn: pointer to an CAN_HandleTypeDef structure that contains the configuration information for the specified CAN.

params.name: RxFifo
params.descEn: Fifo number of the received message to be read. This parameter can be a value of @arg CAN_receive_FIFO_number.
params.descZh: 接收 FIFO 编号：CAN_RX_FIFO0 或 CAN_RX_FIFO1。

params.name: pHeader
params.descEn: pointer to a CAN_RxHeaderTypeDef structure where the header of the Rx frame will be stored.
params.descZh: 报文头结构体：StdId/ExtId（标识符）、IDE（标准帧/扩展帧）、RTR（数据帧/远程帧）、DLC（数据长度 0~8）。

params.name: aData
params.descEn: array where the payload of the Rx frame will be stored.
params.descZh: 数据数组指针。CAN 每帧最多 8 字节（标准帧）。

functions.briefEn: Get an CAN frame from the Rx FIFO zone into the message RAM.
functions.briefZh: 从接收 FIFO 取出一个报文。

functions.name: HAL_CAN_GetRxFifoFillLevel

params.name: hcan
params.descEn: pointer to an CAN_HandleTypeDef structure that contains the configuration information for the specified CAN.

params.name: RxFifo
params.descEn: Rx FIFO. This parameter can be a value of @arg CAN_receive_FIFO_number.
params.descZh: 接收 FIFO 编号：CAN_RX_FIFO0 或 CAN_RX_FIFO1。

functions.returnDescEn: Number of messages available in Rx FIFO.
functions.briefZh: 读取接收 FIFO 中待处理报文的个数。

functions.briefZh: 使能指定的 CAN 通知（发送完成 / 接收挂起 / 错误等），对应回调才会被调用。
